title: M1 Cost fixes that would multiply by tenants, and the standard layout track
description:
Milestone of epic PPY-6a6357 (initiative PPY-25ffa3). Critical-path plan: PPY-e38a2d. Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR #1305).

Entry criteria: M0 (cost fixes may start at once; they are already in progress).
Exit criteria: PPY-7f1e54 stages B and C merged and rolled out (MoM first); PPY-ee02b8 closed including ReferenceIntake's whole-table list; PPY-d647ee incremental reader snapshot; PPY-3fd0aa call-count test at 1 tenant. Front-end track on the M7 path: PPY-31efef cards and brand pack (slices PPY-ecb656, PPY-7bc5b7), the publication preset PPY-cf7e6e, TI's brand-neutral acceptance PPY-7e396d.
Customer-visible: Lower cost on our sites; MoM and TI look unchanged or better.
Index-adding deploys in this milestone: Reference.publicFeedKey (PR #1239), per site, alone, after stage A and the backfill.
Contains: PPY-7f1e54, PPY-ee02b8, PPY-d647ee, PPY-3fd0aa, PPY-31efef, PPY-613a29, PPY-88a883, PPY-cf7e6e, PPY-7e396d
Not gating M7 (recommended off the path; decision D4): PPY-c446fe ordering rule, PPY-2a44b2 native tokens and retiring the scaler. The preset ships on today's token values.
Follows: M0.

Acceptance (Gherkin):
Scenario: Cost does not grow with corpus or tenant count (PPY-3fd0aa)
Scenario: One vote costs a constant number of calls (PPY-d647ee)
Scenario: A card renders from its data alone (PPY-613a29)
Scenario: A story card renders from data in two brands (features_backend/core-cards.feature, PPY-ecb656)
Scenario: A low-contrast pack is refused naming the pair (features_backend/brand-pack-validator.feature, PPY-7bc5b7)
Scenario: A valid pack builds a branded site; A font outside the allow-list is rejected (PPY-88a883)
Scenario: A site picks the preset in configuration only (PPY-cf7e6e)
Scenario: The shared suite passes for a second brand (PPY-7e396d)

Acceptance checks:
1. The home-page snapshot and Reference intake make no whole-table read: the call-count test passes and the MoM AppSync request graph for one week after rollout is flat against corpus growth.
2. TI renders on the preset with only a brand pack, sections and pages: golden renders accepted, git shows no change in the MoM repository.
3. Browser policy checks pass in light and dark for TI and the fixture brand (colour-safe pairs, contrast).
